name: 34461 · Lecanto, FL
findings: ZIP 34461 (Lecanto) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34461 (Lecanto) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
